title: Async Task Queue System
description: Design a simplified asynchronous task queue system.
context: Used in backend systems for background processing (emails, jobs, workers).
codeSnippet:
import asyncio

class TaskQueue:
    def __init__(self):
        self.queue = asyncio.Queue()

    async def add_task(self, task):
        await self.queue.put(task)

    async def worker(self):
        while True:
            task = await self.queue.get()
            print(f'Processing {task}')
            await asyncio.sleep(1)

async def main():
    q = TaskQueue()

    asyncio.create_task(q.worker())

    await q.add_task('job-1')

asyncio.run(main())
